design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (rebuild_contracts_and_draws), rework round 11. Draw: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,6]; rebuild_ext_change_order_signature takes 6, rebuild_ext_final_draw takes 6.

WHY A GOOD TEST. A Houston landlord (Marisol Ibarra) asks only for the final draw on her Unit B rebuild. The final draw rule says its amount "is fixed only after no change order proposal other than a deductive one stands on the contract awaiting the customer's signature"; co 3 (insurance_scope drywall, 412.5 sq ft, naming hidden-damage supplement 1, approved 1,377.75) is pending, so the agent prices it under six factors (carrier approved unit price billed at the written quantity, carrier overhead and profit, category_3 antimicrobial, drying verification after the water job's early release, RRP cleaning verification of a painted-component removal under the contract's lead-safe setup line, and HEPA cleaning of the framing before the walls close), hands the signature to the customer, then works the final draw on a carrier-funded contract: Texas owner retention on the share the customer does not fund (Tex. Prop. Code ch. 53), the owner's share of the code items above the ordinance or law limit, the deductible hold, the owner-item hold, the recoverable depreciation the carrier still withholds, and the carrier pass-through lines.

SCOPE. Claimed: rebuild_ext_change_order_signature (sign_change_order_7ffbf290, user) and rebuild_ext_final_draw (request_final_draw_345d01eb, agent). Task 1 holds the deductive signature, the overdue draw charge and the past-due draw payment.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root rebuild_ext_final_draw; edge to rebuild_ext_change_order_signature, value_input, gate current_sum, state form, policy_source "The final draw's requested amount is fixed only after no change order proposal other than a deductive one stands on the contract awaiting the customer's signature; a proposal whose amount worked out under the change order signature rule falls below the tier's change order minimum is not counted, because it cannot be written."; condition equal to the sentence (co 3 works out above the minimum, so it counts). Only the additive signature write clears it. Opening evidence: co 3 pending_signature, created 2026-10-16 (inside 14 validity days). Order: signature (step 10), final draw (step 15). Deletion run: 17726.05 instead of 19956.83.

FACTOR CARD — change order (2478.65; baseline 1356.71): co_price_basis (method, cross claims) carrier-scope line, 1,377.75 / 412.5 = 3.34 vs the tier rate 2.86 written (schema meaning), billed at the written quantity; baseline 2241.05. co_overhead_profit 20% vs 15%; baseline 2390.58. co_wall_treatment 0.41 x 412.5 written; baseline 2275.70. co_drying_verification customer_release, class_3 -> 145.00 + 95.00; baseline 2238.65. co_lead_safe_work (param): drywall removal on 1962 housing whose contract carries a lead_safe_setup line -> 125.00; baseline 2353.65. co_framing_cleaning (param, cross water): HEPA vacuuming of the framing before closing, 0.52 x 412.5; baseline 2221.25.

FACTOR CARD — final draw (19956.83; baseline 35466.17): fd_state_retainage (method) carrier-funded, 10% of the difference 71,386.17 - 0.00 customer-funded draws = 7,138.617; baseline 27095.45. fd_code_item_hold 1,737.60 - 1,000.00 = 737.60; baseline 20694.43. fd_deductible_hold 2,500.00; baseline 22456.83. fd_owner_item_hold 480.00 + 2,369.92; baseline 22806.75. fd_depreciation_hold 4,236.40 withheld, nothing released; baseline 24193.23. fd_pass_through 1,953.20; baseline 18003.63.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Signature: ch_state, co_signed, co_supplement (insurance_scope, supplement approved 2026-10-14); minimum 150.00; validity 14 days; escalation threshold kept. Final draw: dr_milestone_state, dr_once (dedup binding cites an empty contract field — BLUEPRINT-KNOWN).

SEED. Water job Black Water Standard (category_3, class_3, early release 2026-03-06, invoiced 6,633.95, closed 2026-05-01 after the insurance posting); claim file Direction to Pay (TX, trades 6, ordinance or law limit 1,000.00, deductible due 2,500.00), initial approval 82,350.00 withholding 4,236.40 (2026-04-27), supplement approval 1,377.75, denied-line write-off 480.00, ACV contractor_direct 75,613.60 received 2026-04-30 (depreciation window still open, no release); contract with signed cabinet upgrade (2,369.92), code_required insulation (1,737.60) and a lead_safe_setup line; two carrier_direct draws (the first requested 2026-05-01, after the ACV payment reached the company) posted from the ACV payment after the water job was paid.

STANDARD SOLUTION. locate/verify -> contract -> change orders -> claim file -> requests -> approvals -> water job -> contract charges -> hand signature (2478.65) -> draws -> payments -> carrier payments -> request final draw (substantial_completion, 3, carrier_direct, conditional_final, '', 19956.83).

VERIFICATION. /tmp verify.py with the real tools reproduces every figure; probe table in the worklog; gates green.

REVISIONS. Round 4 closed R3-02, R3-03, R3-04, R3-05(a), C-14 for this task; round 5 closes C-02 (the lead-safe ladder bills no setup inside a change order; worklog REWORK round 5); round 6 labels co_lead_safe_work a parameter, as it selects a fee value (C-05). Round 9 bills a carrier-scope line at its approved amount (no sheet rounding on the carrier's per-unit price) and (until round 10) charged the wall-closing treatment on whole sheets; the change order and the final draw moved. Round 10 charges the wall-closing treatment on the wall area written, replaces the billing-unit factor with the post-completion dumpster and re-cleaning items, and labels the price basis a method; the change order and the final draw moved. Round 11 drops the post-completion items, adds HEPA framing cleaning before closing walls (water, fire and mold tier rates), and re-prices the seeded signed change orders under the rules in force; the change order and the final draw moved.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Ibarra, a Houston landlord who owns a small fourplex and rents out its units. Unit B at 2214 Kipling St flooded with sewage-contaminated water back in March; Ridgecrest dried it out and has been rebuilding it under your insurance claim with Magnolia Gulf. You are organized, a little brisk, and you keep a folder for everything, but you do not know construction billing rules and you say so. You are calling on a weekday morning from your office.

You open by saying the final walkthrough on the Kipling unit was last Wednesday, the crew is basically done, and you would like Ridgecrest to put in the final draw on the rebuild so the insurance side can wrap up. You want the company to request it today; you are authorizing the representative to do that for you on this call. You are not asking for a payment to be taken from you today, only for the final draw to be put in.

You give details only when asked. If asked for your phone number, it is 7135550347. If asked for an email, it is marisol.ibarra@ibarrarentals.com. If asked for a ZIP code, your billing ZIP is 77019. If asked which property, it is Unit B at 2214 Kipling St in Houston. If asked about a mortgage, there is no mortgage on the fourplex. If asked who pays the draws, you believe the insurance money has been going straight to Ridgecrest. If asked for your claim number, you read it off your folder: MGI-26-HO-0083417. If asked about anything you do not have in front of you, such as dates of earlier draws or dollar figures on the account, you say you would rather the representative read them from the records.

If the representative tells you something has to be signed by you before the final draw can go in, you ask what it is and how much, listen, and then agree to sign it. If the figure they give you differs from what you remember seeing on paper, you mention that the paper you were emailed showed thirteen hundred fifty-six and change and ask them to double-check it against the records; once they confirm the figure from the records you accept it and sign. When the representative hands you the signing step, you run it yourself exactly as they describe, using the contract, the document reference and the dollar amount they give you, and you read back what the confirmation says.

Once the representative tells you the final draw has been requested and gives you its amount, you thank them, say you will watch for the paperwork, and end the call. You do not ask for anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.rebuild_contract_id: Value d1c30798-f0fd-4de5-81fd-c9a6b3bbaf87. Basis: the sign tool docstring 'Id class — the reference number of the customer's reconstruction contract the change order amends, as returned by the reconstruction contract lookup'; find_rebuild_contracts(customer_id) returns exactly one contract for Marisol Ibarra, the Kipling St Unit B contract. Uniqueness: she holds one reconstruction contract, and the proposal awaiting signature names it.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.change_order_id: Value 3eabf43b-575b-42cd-9bf7-6f33211d29de. Basis: docstring 'Id class — the reference number of the change order proposal being signed, as returned by the change order lookup for that contract'; find_rebuild_change_orders returns co_number 1 (owner_upgrade, signed), co_number 2 (code_required insulation, signed) and co_number 3 (insurance_scope drywall, pending_signature). Uniqueness: only co_number 3 awaits signature, and the final draw rule waits until no non-deductive proposal awaits signature.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 2478.65 (calculated). Billed quantity: the quantity written, 412.5 sq ft. Unit price: a carrier-scope line (insurance_scope change order on an insurance_claim contract naming hidden-damage supplement 1, approved at 1,377.75) -> 1,377.75 / 412.5 = 3.34 (co_price_basis; baseline tier drywall rate 2.86, which is also the unit price written on the proposal). Line 412.5 x 3.34 = 1,377.75, the approved amount as approved. Wall-closing treatment: preceding water job Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss, category_3 -> antimicrobial 0.41 x 412.5 = 169.125 (co_wall_treatment). Framing cleaning: the same category_3 water job -> HEPA vacuuming 0.52 x 412.5 = 214.50 (co_framing_cleaning). Markup: claim file estimate_trade_count 6 >= Direction to Pay op_min_trades 3 -> 10 + 10 = 20 percent (co_overhead_profit; baseline 15). (1,377.75 + 169.125 + 214.50) x 1.20 = 2,113.65. Verification item: the water job's drying outcome customer_release with class_3 -> moisture mapping 145.00 + thermal imaging 95.00 = 240.00 (co_drying_verification). Lead-safe item: drywall line (removal of painted wall board, never minor repair) on a multifamily_unit built 1962 < RRP cutoff 1978 whose contract carries a lead_safe_setup line -> cleaning verification 125.00 (co_lead_safe_work). Total 2,113.65 + 240.00 + 125.00 = 2,478.65 -> 2478.65; above the 150.00 minimum.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.draw_number: Value 3. argument_uniqueness_tracing.funding_route: Value carrier_direct. Basis: base rebuild_draws rule 'The funding route is mortgagee_release when the linked claim file names a mortgagee and its dwelling-coverage payment was routed to the mortgagee's loss-draft account, carrier_direct when the dwelling payment reached the company, and customer otherwise'; claim file mortgagee_name is empty and the dwelling ACV payment EFT-MG-55203417 has payee_route contractor_direct. Uniqueness: mortgagee_release fails (no mortgagee); customer applies only 'otherwise'; carrier_direct holds.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.lien_waiver_type: Value conditional_final. Basis: base rebuild_draws rule 'On tiers that require it, each draw request carries a conditional progress lien waiver, and the substantial_completion draw a conditional final waiver'; Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement has lien_waiver_with_each_draw true. Uniqueness: none fails (the tier requires waivers); conditional_progress belongs to interim draws; this is the substantial_completion draw.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.due_date: Value '' (empty). Basis: base rebuild_draws rule 'A customer-funded draw is due the tier's draw due days after the request date' and the docstring 'or an empty string when the draw carries no due date'; the earlier carrier_direct draws on the contract carry an empty due_date. Uniqueness: the route is carrier_direct, not customer, so no due date applies.
